newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-DANIEL PRODAN TO MOVE TO ATLETICO MADRID.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DANIEL PRODAN TO MOVE TO ATLETICO MADRID.

text.p: Romanian national team defender Daniel Prodan said on Sunday he had signed a three-year contract with Spanish champions Atletico Madrid.
"My contract with Steaua is over so I agreed with Atletico's directors to work with them for the next three years," Prodan said by telephone. "Steaua and Atletico now have to negotiate the transfer."
Prodan, 27, has played 33 times for Romania. He disclosed no details of the deal.
